content: Implement repository and validation schemas for user sport preferences management
activeForm: Implementing repository and validation schemas for user sport preferences management
description: Implement user-sports.repository.ts with addUserSport, removeUserSport, and getUserSports methods for managing the user_sports junction table. Implements INSERT/DELETE operations with unique constraint handling (user_id, sport_name). Create Zod validation schemas for POST payload (sport_name, skill_level, years_experience, preferred_position) and DELETE params. Write 8 MVP-tier tests (4 unit tests for repository methods, 4 integration tests for database operations and constraints). This subtask provides the data access layer and validation that will be used by controllers in T4.2.

checkpoints.name: Repository Methods Complete
checkpoints.requirement: Repository methods addUserSport, removeUserSport, getUserSports implemented with proper SQL queries

checkpoints.name: Validation Schemas and Tests Passing
checkpoints.requirement: Zod schemas created and all 8 tests passing (repository methods and database constraints verified)

phases.name: Repository Implementation
actions: Create: src/services/user-service/repositories/user-sports.repository.ts
Implement: addUserSport(userId: number, sportData: AddSportPayload): Promise<UserSport>
Build: SQL INSERT query with unique constraint handling (user_id, sport_name)
Implement: removeUserSport(userId: number, sportName: string): Promise<boolean>
Build: SQL DELETE query for user_sports junction table
Implement: getUserSports(userId: number): Promise<UserSport[]>
Build: SQL SELECT query with JOIN to sports table (optional)
Handle: Unique constraint violations (return 409 conflict indicator)
Handle: Foreign key constraints (user_id must exist in users table)
phases.gate: All three repository methods must be implemented with proper error handling before proceeding

phases.name: Validation Schema Implementation
actions: Create: src/services/user-service/schemas/user-sports.schema.ts
Implement: addSportSchema with Zod validation
Validate: sport_name (string, required, enum: ['pickleball', 'paddle'])
Validate: skill_level (enum: ['beginner', 'intermediate', 'advanced', 'expert'], required)
Validate: years_experience (number, optional, min: 0, max: 50)
Validate: preferred_position (string, optional, max: 100 chars)
Implement: deleteSportSchema for URL params validation
Validate: userId (number, required) and sportName (string, required)
Export: schemas for controller use in T4.2

phases.name: MVP Test Suite (8 tests)
actions: Write: 4 unit tests for repository method logic and query generation
Test: addUserSport successful insertion
Test: removeUserSport successful deletion
Test: getUserSports returns array of sports
Test: Duplicate sport rejection (unique constraint)
Write: 4 integration tests for database operations
Test: INSERT with valid payload succeeds
Test: INSERT duplicate sport returns conflict
Test: DELETE existing sport succeeds
Test: Foreign key constraint on user_id enforced
Verify: All 8 tests passing with 90%+ coverage of repository and validation layers
